answers.solution:
Wrote the solution to `/home/kara/solution.md`.

**Diagnosis:** The release tick cuts the annotated tag on release-prep HEAD, then the coding-hermes board close-out creates one more commit on `main`. The tier2 criterion requires `tag == HEAD`, so `git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD` fails and the whole conjunctive check fails.

**Fix, verified in sandboxes:**
- **Prevention:** land all content commits *and* the board close-out commit, push, then tag the pushed HEAD last, push the tag, then create the GitHub release. No commit-creating action may follow the tag in the same close-out.
- **Repair:** `git tag -a -f v0.1.8 -m "v0.1.8" HEAD`, `git push --force origin refs/tags/v0.1.8`, verify with `git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD` and `git ls-remote`, note the correction on the board, then re-run `gitreins task complete`.

I reproduced the failure state (tag `099750f` vs HEAD `9b98c9a`), confirmed the repair yields `tag==HEAD PASS` with an annotated tag, and confirmed the correct-order sequence also passes. The doc includes a one-shot acceptance gate and a close-out checklist.
